offers_products.reason: Makes, packages and sells Coca-Cola and partner beverages: sparkling drinks, water, tea, coffee, energy drinks.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from beverage sales; delivery and customer care are incidental to the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Branded beverages reach about 60 million consumers via stores; shoppers choose the brands.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Delivers to retailers, restaurants, entertainment venues and offices that buy beverages for resale or use.

recurring_revenue.reason: Retail and restaurant customers reorder beverages on scheduled routes; the same accounts buy repeatedly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Everyday low-cost beverages and staples-like purchases; demand is stable in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent small purchases of cases and bottles of beverages.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured beverages; it is a bottler and distributor of goods.

large_customers.reason: Sells to households and many retailers, restaurants and venues of all sizes, though large grocers matter.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs multiple manufacturing plants, 60 distribution centers and delivery truck fleets.
